items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Once in New York I visited him way up in the 130s in the rich colored neighborhoods, where Ellington and others on that level lived.

ctx.x: What was he doing while he was doing this? Was this connected to the evangelist thing that you mentioned earlier?
No, I think that’s more connected to his ego. He became very successful. He was a model for what I wanted to be. Once in New York I visited him way up in the 130s
in the rich colored neighborhoods, where Ellington and others on that level lived. I was floored when his French maid opened the door. He was something.
